# BJJ-US

> BJJ-US is a gym management software platform and branded member mobile app built exclusively for Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) academies in the United States.

## Entity Clarification
- **Name:** BJJ-US
- **Category:** Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Gym Management Software (SaaS) & Branded Member App
- **Website:** https://bjj-us.com/
- **Platforms:** Web (Admin & Professor Console) and iOS (Member App)
- **Languages:** English and Portuguese (Spanish, Italian, and French planned)

## Core Differentiators
- **Confirmed Mat-Side Check-In:** One-tap member check-in with arrival confirmation or professor verification after class. Every confirmed class counts toward belt promotion tracking.
- **0.0% Platform Billing Markup:** Direct Stripe Connect integration. Gyms keep 100% of tuition minus standard Stripe processing fees with zero SaaS percentage surcharge on memberships, pro-shop gear, or paid seminars.
- **Native IBJJF Adult & Kids Belt Tracking:** Tracks adult belts (White through Black, Coral, Red) and kids belts (Gray through Green) by age, minimum time-in-grade, and confirmed training days. Professors always make the final promotion decision.
- **Included Branded Gym App:** Members download BJJ-US free and join via gym invite code; the app immediately reflects the academy's name, logo, and brand colors with no app store rebuild required.
- **Digital Waivers & Family Accounts:** Parents manage multiple children under one account; trial students sign digital waivers in-app or online before their first class.

## Pricing
- Every gym starts with a 14-day free trial.
- For pricing, email support@bjj-us.com.
- 0.0% platform surcharge on Stripe payments, and members always download the app for free.
